backend.deploy: autoDeploy from main; the production answer response carried raw_primary_turns, which only 9f87930 returns.

failure_diagnosis.observed: Intermittent 503 llm_unavailable on writes and answers (2 on production before diagnostics, 1 in local validation, 1 on production after).
failure_diagnosis.cause: Provider google.genai ServerError with HTTP 503 after the backend's two attempts (local server log: 'Live demo failed: type=ServerError provider_code=503'; production response detail kind=ServerError provider_code=503 on the post-deploy run).
failure_diagnosis.also: A 429 'Model rate limit reached' in local validation came from the 10-requests-per-minute limiter when presets ran back to back; production shares the same per-minute limit across visitors.
failure_diagnosis.mitigation: The page retries a provider 503 once after 5 s; writes reuse their request_id. The backend attempt count was left at two because capacity is reserved per maximum attempt and never refunded.

preset_validation.environment: local demo-api (this commit's backend code before the final reporting change), real Gemini key from the local .env, configs/fallback.yaml models, separate scratch store; not the production quota
